_help: Routing rules for PrintRouter. Rules are checked top to bottom; the FIRST rule whose 'if' matches picks the printer.
Conditions in 'if' (all must match): color true/false, content 'document'/'pictures', duplex true/false,
paper, paper_type or tray (a value or a list of values).
paper_types and trays must be spelled exactly as the printer drivers name them; they are sent to the printer with each job.
content is only decided for color jobs: Auto mode counts a job as 'pictures' when the average color coverage
of its pages is at least picture_threshold_percent.
Files put in inbox_folder (also inside folders in it) appear in the app by themselves; once printed
they are moved to printed_folder, into a folder with the date. Both are next to the app unless a full path is given.

rotate_sort._help: Ticked by hand per file (A4 only). Copies take turns between these trays (A4 portrait / A4 landscape), so each copy lies crosswise on the one before. Keeps alternating across all files in one print run.

product_papers._help: PrintHub products: the website's Paper choice -> the driver paper type for print.pdf. EXAMPLES, to be checked by the owner. A paper not listed here is picked by hand at Layout done.

rules.reason: Thick 4 paper (IM C3000 takes up to Thick 3)
